html:
The Battle of Nicopolis was fought on 25 September 1396 on the Danube in northern Bulgaria, where the Ottoman sultan Bayezid I destroyed a crusader army led by King Sigismund of Hungary.

French, Burgundian, German and Hungarian knights had come to stop the Ottoman advance, which had already taken most of Bulgaria. The French knights charged ahead without waiting for Sigismund's plan, broke through the Ottoman foot soldiers and were then cut down by Bayezid's cavalry and his Serbian vassals. Thousands of prisoners were killed, and nobles were ransomed. Sigismund escaped by boat. It was the last large scale crusade of the Middle Ages, and the Ottomans held Bulgaria until the war of 1877 and 1878.
sum: The Battle of Nicopolis was fought on 25 September 1396 on the Danube in northern Bulgaria, where the Ottoman sultan Bayezid I destroyed a crusader army led by King Sigismund of Hungary.
